panels.title: Incident data source and time range (read first)

options.content: **Incident data source.** Incidents and telemetry events on this dashboard come from the **Phase 4 ingestion pipeline** (S3 → SQS → worker → RDS). The first synthetic incidents were ingested **2026-11-17 02:17 UTC**; event timestamps are the synthetic events' observation times (ObservedAtUtc ≈ IngestedAtUtc) — these are NOT historical 2021–2026 measurements and must not be read as newly occurring operational incidents. **Default range: last 30 days** so the ingested incident data is visible; the panels without a time filter (notification state, linkage audit, event/incident totals) always reflect the full pipeline history. For the complete 2021–2026 historical ALERT record (8,094 alerts across the synthetic dataset), see the [Cold-Chain Operations Overview](/grafana/d/cold-chain-unified/cold-chain-unified) dashboard.

targets.rawSql: SELECT Provenance, COUNT(*) AS incidents FROM FDE_VIEWS.VW_TELEMETRY_INCIDENTS WHERE $__timeFilter(ObservedAtUtc) GROUP BY Provenance

SELECT TOP (100) IncidentId, ShipmentId, ObservedAtUtc, TemperatureC, ThresholdC, Provenance, Status FROM FDE_VIEWS.VW_TELEMETRY_INCIDENTS WHERE $__timeFilter(ObservedAtUtc) ORDER BY ObservedAtUtc DESC
SELECT $__time(ObservedAtUtc), TemperatureC AS value, Provenance AS metric FROM FDE_VIEWS.VW_TELEMETRY_EVENTS WHERE $__timeFilter(ObservedAtUtc) ORDER BY ObservedAtUtc

panels.title: Notification state (SNS-acked != delivered — blueprint 03 §B4)
panels.description: Phase 4: derived per-incident notification state from the append-only attempt ledger (dbo.IncidentNotificationAttempts). sns_acked = the SNS TOPIC accepted the message; recipient delivery is observed only via topic CloudWatch metrics.

targets.rawSql: SELECT NotificationState, COUNT(*) AS incidents FROM FDE_VIEWS.VW_INCIDENT_NOTIFICATIONS GROUP BY NotificationState

panels.title: Incidents with notification attempts (latest 50)
panels.description: Phase 4: reconcile visibility — AttemptCount, ack state and last attempt time per incident (append-only ledger, R3-2).

targets.rawSql: SELECT TOP (50) IncidentId, ShipmentId, Provenance, NotificationState, AttemptCount, AckedCount, LastAttemptAtUtc FROM FDE_VIEWS.VW_INCIDENT_NOTIFICATIONS ORDER BY COALESCE(LastAttemptAtUtc, CreatedAtUtc) DESC

panels.title: C4 linkage validation failures (events referencing unknown shipments)
panels.description: Phase 4 audit backstop: should always be 0 — the worker rejects bad shipment refs into the DLQ at ingest time.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM FDE_VIEWS.VW_EVENT_LINK_VALIDATION

panels.title: Events ingested (provenance split)
panels.description: Phase 4: total events in the separate ingested stream (dbo.TelemetryEvents) — never appended to unified.telemetry.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM FDE_VIEWS.VW_TELEMETRY_EVENTS

panels.title: Incidents by provenance (total)
panels.description: Total incidents across the full ingested stream (no time filter).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM FDE_VIEWS.VW_TELEMETRY_INCIDENTS
